description:
Rewrite the Beadwork parent prompt appendix for goal mode and interactive mode. This issue owns **all** standing prompt copy for review policy, child task composition, and anti-supervisor language.

## Background

`prompt.ts` currently tells the parent it is in run mode and to delegate via beadwork worker tools. New run mode: standing appendix is policy only (does not start a turn). `/bw run` injects a separate go-prompt.

Interactive mode stays human-led: no injected go-prompt, no autonomous fleet.

## Must appear in run-mode appendix

- Use `orchestrate` (not delegate/tmux). `spawn` only when the parent intends to wait.
- `beadwork_start_issue` before work; do not close from child settlement.
- Compose the child `task` yourself (no wrap hook). Include ticket/epic facts, “do not close tickets”, shared-checkout discipline, encourage prose handoff (summary, commits, commands run, blockers). No schema.
- Domain metadata on orchestrate: source=beadwork, scopeId, workItemId, title.
- **ticket (default):** independent `reviewImplementation` child before close. Disposition every finding as fix (blocking), file (nonblocking follow-up unless user waives a blocker in an ordinary turn), reject (record why). No keyword classifier.
- **scope:** may close tickets from evidence; independent `reviewScope` before epic complete; dependents may start before aggregate review — state that tradeoff.
- **none:** skip independent review children; still use Git/bw judgment to close.
- Review children: `git show` / commits / ticket id, not “read the whole dirty workspace”. Do not start review of A while A's implementer is still live (instruction, not a lock).
- Quality commands (lint/test/typecheck) are implementer/reviewer/repo-checkpoint work, not a beadwork gate.
- Do not mention tmux, delegate, worker_done, landing, --workers, polling.

## Files

- `packages/pi-beadwork-extension/src/prompt.ts` only
- unit tests / golden strings

## Success criteria

- Appendix contains orchestrate + start-before-work + settlement≠close + all three review policies as distinct branches.
- Neutral mode still returns undefined.

## Test plan

- Unit: run vs interactive vs neutral.
- Unit: ticket vs scope vs none strings (scope mentions dependent-start tradeoff; none does not require reviewImplementation; ticket does).
- Unit: reviewer guidance mentions git objects/commits, not only workspace reads.
- Golden/fixture files so later prompt edits are reviewable diffs.
- Log which policy branch was selected in test output.

## Considerations

Do not inject a turn from this module. Sibling 4.1 is additional regressions against this copy, not a second rewrite.

comments.text: Owns all standing review-policy copy. 4.1 is goldens only — do not fork a second prompt.ts rewrite.

title: Rewrite Beadwork goal-mode prompt appendix for orchestrate
